data: Tesla reported total revenue of about **$97.7 billion** for fiscal 2024, which ended December 31, 2024. NVIDIA reported about **$60.9 billion** for its fiscal 2024, which ended January 28, 2024. On those labels, **Tesla was roughly 1.6 times larger**. The two fiscal years barely overlap, though. NVIDIA's fiscal 2024 mostly covers calendar 2023, so a calendar-aligned comparison uses NVIDIA's fiscal 2025, ended January 26, 2025, when revenue reached about $130.5 billion. On that basis, **NVIDIA was roughly 1.34 times larger** than Tesla.
